summary: The clips of “android” from the `synthetic-wakewords-android` test set, placed between seconds of read speech, followed by hours of audio with no wake word. A detector streams every recording and is scored on the wake words it caught and on how often per hour it woke with no wake word.
notes: Built by scripts/publish_ww_stream_bench.py from `synthetic-wakewords-android` at OpenVoiceOS/synthetic-wakewords@73211e16 (400 of 2224 clips with the phrase) and the shared negative recordings.
